theme: 3 terms for depth and color in SwiftUI: a lifted card, a smooth color change and a blurred background

terms.definition: A soft dark copy behind a view that makes it look lifted from the screen.
terms.example: Add a Shadow, so the card stands out.

terms.definition: A color effect that changes smoothly from one color to another along a straight line.
terms.example: Use a LinearGradient from blue to purple for the header.

terms.definition: A blurred, see-through background that lets the content behind it shine through.
terms.example: Put the controls on a Material, so the photo stays visible.

video.title: Shadow, LinearGradient & Material | Day 157
video.description:
Learn to explain how to add depth and color to a SwiftUI card: Shadow, LinearGradient & Material, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Shadow - A soft dark copy behind a view that makes it look lifted from the screen.
LinearGradient - A color effect that changes smoothly from one color to another along a straight line.
Material - A blurred, see-through background that lets the content behind it shine through.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 157 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Shadow, LinearGradient & Material | Day 157
landscape.description:
Explain Shadow, LinearGradient & Material in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
섀도, 리니어그레이디언트, 머티리얼 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Shadow - A soft dark copy behind a view that makes it look lifted from the screen.
한국어: 섀도: 뷰 뒤에 깔리는 부드러운 어두운 복사본으로, 뷰가 떠 있는 것처럼 보이게 해 줘요

LinearGradient - A color effect that changes smoothly from one color to another along a straight line.
한국어: 리니어그레이디언트: 직선을 따라 한 색에서 다른 색으로 부드럽게 변하는 색 효과

Material - A blurred, see-through background that lets the content behind it shine through.
한국어: 머티리얼: 뒤에 있는 내용이 비쳐 보이는, 흐릿하고 투명한 배경

In this video, Mina and Jake make a flat card look nicer, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Shadow, LinearGradient and Material in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my card looks flat on the new background.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Shadow. It is a soft dark copy behind the view, so the card looks lifted.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I added `.shadow(radius: 8)`, and it looks better.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Do not make the Shadow too dark.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The background is only one color. Can I make it nicer?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a LinearGradient. It changes smoothly from one color to another along a line.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I set `.top` and `.bottom` as the start and the end of the LinearGradient.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great. Now the card needs a see-through look.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A Material is a blurred background, and the content behind it shines through.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used `.ultraThinMaterial`. Is that the thinnest one?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A thicker Material shows less of the gradient behind it.
